C1.worst_defect: The hero tells me what it is ('Point of sale for Vendure', 'Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0') but nothing above the fold says what I must ask my developer to do before staff can sell; on phone the hero till screenshot is cropped so the 'Add charge' button under 'Order discount' is cut off.

C2.worst_defect: Honest about refunds, but in owner terms it falls back to developer language: a refund 'stays Pending until it is settled' via 'the Admin API's settleRefund mutation', and the demo sends 'anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com' with no plain word on what that is.
C2.where: limitations.desktop.01 / text/limitations; home 'Live demo or your own store' table (home.desktop.02)

C3.worst_defect: Step 4 lists the device-key permissions, then separately says 'Also add ReadOrder, or the till sells but its order history is refused', which is easy to miss when copying the list; step 8 'Sign in and make a sale' has sub-steps a–i with no screenshot of the sign-in screen.

C4.worst_defect: 'Count the drawer and close the day', the section I would train staff on, lists what the Z report contains but shows no picture of the close screen or the Z report; and 'Hand over signs you out and leaves the drawer open for the next account' reads like the physical cash drawer, which the till cannot open.

C5.worst_defect: 'What it does today' is ten identical grey text cards with no icons or grouping, so the list I most want to scan reads as a wall; dark mode holds up.

C6.worst_defect: No horizontal overflow, but the hero till screenshot is cropped ('Add charge' cut off), long quick-start headings wrap to three lines, and the phone cashier-sheet image carries a grey left strip that the desktop one lacks.

C7.worst_defect: Lighthouse 97-100 everywhere, titles, descriptions, JSON-LD, llms.txt, sitemap, robots, search and 404 all fine; only blemishes are quick-start LCP 2.6 s (score 0.88, render-blocking requests) and the thin Limitations description 'What VendurePOS does not do yet.'

overall_worst.defect: At the till's 'Count the drawer and close the day' section, the page I would hand staff to learn closing up, has no screenshot of the close screen or the Z report; the page's only pictures are the payment screen and the cashier sheet, so I cannot see what closing the day looks like before trying it.
overall_worst.fix: Add a screenshot of the closure/count screen and of the resulting Z report under 'Count the drawer and close the day', and reword 'leaves the drawer open for the next account' to 'leaves the register session open for the next cashier'.
